loadBalance.absoluteForceFloorSource: M043 measurement on real BM4: accumulated free-DOF residual leakage into the reaction sum reaches 80.3 N against an exactly-zero applied horizontal load at condition ~1.7e15
loadBalance.absoluteMomentFloorSource: M043 measurement on real BM4: RX reaction-sum delta 0.35-0.39 N*m against a ~10 N*m reference is at the same noise scale

authorityDisplacementPrecision.source: Output_BM4.xml serialises all 4704 DISPLACEMENT_REPORT values to exactly 6 decimal places in mm./deg.; half-ulp of that format
authorityDisplacementPrecision.elementNoiseBudgetSource: M043: set at the same scale as the measured L2 reaction-sum noise floor; corresponds to admitting |K| up to ~1.1e10 N/m at this authority precision

findings.detail: Free-DOF residual sums to 8884.72 N (232% of load scale); a load present in one model and absent in the other cannot cancel internally.
Mean axial fraction is 0.278; the residual is transverse, so a suppressed axial/pressure term is not the driver.
